sql_schemas: table leave_type | fields: id, name, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: name: unique lookup by leave type name (annual, sick, emergency)

table leave_request | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, start_date, end_date, total_days, reason, status, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_comment, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id; leave_type_id -> leave_type.id; reviewed_by -> employee.id | indexes: employee_id: frequent lookups by employee for their own requests; status: filtering by pending/approved/rejected for manager queues; leave_type_id: filtering requests by leave type; start_date, end_date: date-range queries for calendar views and overlap detection; reviewed_by: manager audit of their own decisions

table leave_balance | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, year, total_allocated, used_days, pending_days, carried_over, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employee.id; leave_type_id -> leave_type.id | indexes: employee_id, leave_type_id, year: unique composite lookup for balance queries per employee per type per year; employee_id: balance summary for employee dashboard; leave_type_id: aggregate balance reporting by leave type

table leave_policy | fields: id, leave_type_id, name, max_days_per_year, max_consecutive_days, requires_attachment, carry_over_allowed, max_carry_over_days, notice_days_required, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: leave_type_id -> leave_type.id | indexes: leave_type_id: policy lookup by leave type; is_active: filtering active policies

table audit_log | fields: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_id, changes, created_at | pk: id | fks: actor_id -> employee.id | indexes: entity_type, entity_id: audit trail lookup for a specific entity; actor_id: audit trail by actor; created_at: time-range audit queries; action: filtering by action type (create, update, delete, approve, reject)

table employee | fields: id, first_name, last_name, email, role, manager_id, department, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: manager_id -> employee.id | indexes: email: unique login lookup; manager_id: direct reports query for manager approval queues; role: RBAC enforcement queries; department: departmental leave calendar views
data_notes: Persistence slice for leave management module. Six conceptual tables defined: employee (referenced by all leave tables), leave_type (enumeration of annual/sick/emergency), leave_policy (configurable rules per leave type), leave_balance (per-employee-per-type-per-year tracking with pending/used/carried-over), leave_request (the core leave application with status lifecycle), and audit_log (GP-002 compliance for all state-changing operations). Six repository interfaces, each with a concrete Pg* implementation backed by the existing pg Pool at src/shared/db/connection.ts. Index rationale reflects access patterns: employee lookups, manager approval queues (by status + manager), date-range overlap detection, balance composite uniqueness, and audit trail queries.
